name: Newfoundland and Labrador Provincial Nominee Program (NLPNP)
description: Skilled-worker streams of the Newfoundland and Labrador Provincial Nominee Program (NLPNP) and whether they run through Express Entry (an Express Entry-aligned nomination adds 600 CRS points).

attributes.legal_status: in force on the access date (provincial programme under a federal–provincial agreement)

skilled_worker_streams.summary: Full-time job offer from a NL employer
In the federal pool, at least 67/100 on the provincial grid, full-time NL job offer

attributes.express_entry_aligned: Yes — Express Entry Skilled Worker category
attributes.notes: Application window after invitation cut from 60 to 30 days (page updated 25 September 2026).
attributes.status_dependency: Eligibility depends on occupation (NOC/TEER), job offer, language scores and existing ties to the province — all unknown (USER-PROFILE.md; OPEN-QUESTIONS.md items 2, 4, 7).

sources.title: Express Entry Skilled Worker Category Application Guide

verification.notes: Read through search-engine extracts of the provincial programme's official pages, not fetched in full.

limitations: Stream rules change several times a year and intake is often by invitation only; read the provincial guide in force before applying.
